title: Task Contract
description: Formal contract for a task that crosses more than one pipeline/loop/handoff boundary. See policies/goal-driven-execution.md for when to use this vs. an inline goal restatement. Consumed by scripts/auto-loop/contract.mjs (--contract flag).

contract_version.description: Bump when the contract itself is edited mid-task (e.g. scope renegotiated) — lets a trace correlate which contract version a given run acted on.

goal.description: Verifiable goal, one sentence. Same bar as policies/goal-driven-execution.md's rewrite table.

inputs.description: Relevant files/specs/issues the agent should read before acting.

constraints.description: What must not change (public API, schema, dependencies).

done_when.description: Observable, testable criteria — not a vague phrase. Checked against agent output; loop keeps running until all are satisfied or escalate_when fires.

escalate_when.description: Explicit conditions that should stop the loop and surface to a human instead of letting the agent invent a way forward.
